name: My Second Family
source:
The story begins as the MC arrives at his aunt's house in America, where he recently moved in from Japan, where his family lives at the moment. He lives with his aunt and his both cousins, while his uncle is on a business trip.

You have the possibility to follow different paths when you interact with people, depending on your actions and answers, the story will be different.

[From [url=https://kyusodev.itch.io/my-second-family]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事从主角抵达姑妈家开始。他最近从日本搬来美国；他的家人目前仍住在日本。姑妈和两名表亲与他同住，而姑父正在出差。

你可以通过与他人互动选择不同路线。你的行动和回答会改变故事的发展。

[来源：[url=https://kyusodev.itch.io/my-second-family]Itch.io[/url]]
